03 / The designer

Meet
Lamis Jijah.

I’m an architectural designer, interior-focused creative, and 3D visualizer based in Muscat — and the Founder & Creative Director of Aphrodite Design Studio. My practice moves between spatial design, architectural storytelling, and visual communication, connecting a designer’s intuition with a strong technical foundation.

With experience spanning architecture, visualization and multidisciplinary creative production, I’m also pursuing an MSc in Building Information Modeling & Management (BIMM), exploring the evolving relationship between design, technology and cultural identity.
